definitions: Ultimately; in the final analysis; when all is said and done.
When considering the most important point.
examples: At the end of the day, it's about making customers happy.
We can discuss all the details, but at the end of the day, the budget is fixed.
He has many talents, but at the end of the day, his dedication is what truly matters.
lemma: at the end of the day
synonyms: when all is said and done
source: at the end of the day
